issue.title: [Practice] Inventory CSV raises a conversion error
issue.body:
This is an invented practice report for this assignment repository, drafted with Codex. It is not an upstream bug report.

### Environment
DuckDB 1.4.1 command-line client on Ubuntu 24.04, x86_64.

### Problem
Reading my local inventory CSV produces a conversion error instead of returning its records.

### Exact query
```sql
SELECT * FROM read_csv('inventory.csv');
```
There are no additional CSV options. I have not attached the CSV contents or copied the full error message.
